description: You are a Digital Researcher for a publishing company compiling assets for a book on 'Art of the New Deal'. Navigate to the Library of Congress website (https://www.loc.gov) and search for 'WPA Poster National Park'. Filter for 'Images' that are 'Available Online'. Curate and download 3 distinct high-resolution WPA National Park posters (e.g., Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, Zion). For each poster, download the highest resolution image available (TIFF or high-res JPEG, typically >20MB; do NOT download thumbnails or web reference images). Save the files to '~/Documents/curated_images/' with descriptive filenames. Create a citation file at '~/Documents/curated_images/credits.json' containing a list of objects with keys: 'title', 'date', 'call_number', 'download_filename', and 'source_url' for each image.
